## What changed?

Add `scripts/velocity-report.py` to print weekly UTC metrics for `synthetic/project` through read-only `gh api` requests behind one `gh_json` function. Support `--since`, text output and `--json`: median PR open-to-merge time, distinct tested revisions and inline review comments per merged PR, observed green-to-queue gaps, CI duration median/p90, and merge queue removal counts.

Paginate PRs, Actions runs and queue timelines. Reject capped or incomplete Actions responses instead of silently reporting partial totals. Document metric definitions, retained-history limitations and API approximations in `docs/VELOCITY_REPORT.md`, linked from `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Tests use synthetic JSON without network access. The change is about 440 lines.

Green-to-queue uses observed Actions workflows, not historical required-check attestation. CI duration uses `updated_at - run_started_at`. Comment counts reflect the current snapshot; deleted runs and comments cannot be reconstructed.

Fix level: implementation validation rejects short Actions pages; a contributor documentation contract keeps the usage entry discoverable. New regressions failed before these fixes against the uncommitted implementation based on `a08c09e`; there is no historical feature implementation commit to name.

## How was it tested?

All commands below ran through the required logger. The outputs shown are real, trimmed outputs from this finishing attempt. Earlier attempt records remain in `tests.log`.

Test-first validation, before fixing incomplete pagination and linking the usage guide (exit 1):

```console
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -n 1 tests/test_velocity_report.py tests/test_documentation.py::test_contributor_entry_points_stay_short_and_public_safe -q  -o tmp_path_retention_policy=failed
```

```text

FAILED tests/test_documentation.py::test_contributor_entry_points_stay_short_and_public_safe
2 failed, 9 passed in 0.52s
```

Final relevant suite, including the required fixture-write policy (exit 0):

```console
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -n 1 tests/test_velocity_report.py tests/test_fixture_write_policy.py tests/test_documentation.py -q  -o tmp_path_retention_policy=failed
```

```text
80 passed in 20.22s
```

Coverage includes weekly metrics, empty samples, failed and unfinished CI, deduplicated revisions, exact time boundaries, unmerged queue drops, CLI JSON/text and input errors, the subprocess boundary, REST and timeline pagination, the Actions cap, and incomplete pages. The new tests perform no raw file writes.
